title: Rayukan Tarko
intro: Kuna komawa zuwa zamanin da wani shugaba mai tausayi ya buƙaci cikakken bauta ga allolin ƙarya. Ƙaramin al'umma mai sadaukarwa ta ƙi, kuma ta fuskanci hukunci mai tsanani har ta zama la'ana har abada. Labarinsu yana ta yawo a cikin Alƙur'ani a matsayin shaida ga imani mai ƙarfi. Za ku iya gane wannan ƙungiyar mai aminci?
clues: Mun zauna a ƙasa ƙarƙashin mulkin kama-karya na wani mai mulki wanda ya buƙaci a bauta wa allolin ƙarya
Al'ummarmu ta fuskanci tsanantawa mai tsanani kawai saboda imaninmu ga Allah shi kaɗai
Mai mulkin ya ba da umarnin a haƙa babban rami a kuma ƙona shi da harshen wuta mai zafi
Domin mun ƙi yin watsi da imaninmu, an jefa mu cikin wannan rami mai ƙonewa ɗaya bayan ɗaya
Labarinmu ya zama wani ɓangare na Alƙur'ani, kuma waɗanda suka tsananta mana an la'ance su har abada.
An sanya wa surar da ta rubuta jarrabawarmu suna ne bayan manyan alamomin sama na sama.

identity.label: Su waye Mu?
options: Sahabban Madatsar Ruwa (Ashab al-Ukhdud)
Mutanen Kogo (Ashab al-Kahf)
Mutanen Asabar
Mutanen A'ad
Mutanen Samudawa

trial.label: Gwajinmu
options: Ana ƙonewa da rai a cikin rami mai wuta
An rufe shi a cikin kogo tsawon shekaru da yawa
Kamun kifi a ranar hutu mai tsarki
Iska mai ƙarfi ta lalata ta
Kashe raƙumi mai tsarki
trial.answer: Ana ƙonewa da rai a cikin rami mai wuta

location.label: Babban Abu
options: Wata rami mai kama da wuta mai ci
Kogo mai ɓoye tare da kare mai aminci
Dogayen ginshiƙai na tsohon birni da aka halaka
Gidajen tsaunuka da aka sassaka su cikin duwatsu
Fili buɗaɗɗen fili wanda iska mai ƙarfi ke sharewa
location.answer: Wata rami mai kama da wuta mai ci

outcome.label: Sakamakonmu
options: Mun yi shahada kuma an la'ance masu tsananta mana har abada
Mun farka bayan mun yi barci na tsawon shekaru 309
An mayar da mu birrai saboda laifinmu
Iska mai ƙarfi ta lalata mu duka
Kuka guda ɗaya mai ɓarna ta wargaza rayuwarmu
outcome.answer: Mun yi shahada kuma an la'ance masu tsananta mana har abada

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
